package.name: odometry_calculator
package.description: This package is designed to calculate the odometry based on the incoming odometry messages. It subscribes to the /rtk_gps_node/odom topic, calculates the 2D and 3D distances traveled, and publishes the results on the /APU/Nav/State/Odometer topic. Additionally, it saves the total and current distances to a file periodically.
